### Elders for the Church on Crete
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/elders-church-crete
Passage: Titus 1:5-6
Points:
- Local churches need pastors and elders to guide the congregation and guard against false teaching.
- Paul tasked Titus with establishing order and appointing qualified local leaders in every Cretan town.
- Because Crete was a central trade hub, church leaders needed to live above reproach to protect the church's reputation.
- Being blameless does not mean sinless perfection, but rather ongoing repentance and continual turning to Christ for forgiveness.
